title: Tok Tam Malaysian's folk tales episode 6
summary:
“ Tok Tam” revolves around a group of animal who live in a small Malaysian Village. They lives in a barn led by an old wise Turkey, Tok Tam. Along with him there are the family of Jaguh the rooster, Bu the hen and their chicks, Chick and Chack. There are also Misai the cat, Mak Boo the cow, Pak Bekk the goat, Cik Lenggang the duck and Cik Siti the mouse. In the series, Tok Tam will tell moral stories fill with message and values for the viewers.
